geography.note: mapSize is the share of the globe the map covers (1080 px x 0.5 km = 540 km, about 4.9 degrees of latitude). latitude 29.4 puts the map at about 33.6-38.4 N, so Act I sits near 35.4 N.

climate.note: Natural climate shared by both eras. Wind angle per 30-degree band, north pole to south pole: 45 = from the south-west (westerlies, tier 1 covers the whole map); 225 = trades from the north-east. The present-day drought is applied in eras/now.

generation.note: No procedural states, towns, religions or markers: places are added by hand from the story bible.
